data.exact_reserve_text: Loss experience on all year of account has been significantly worse than anticipated and reserves have been strengthened to reflect experience. The underwriting loss of GBP 151,717k, analysed below, comprises adverse movements on all underwriting years. Prior to the external RITC transaction being concluded, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k, taking the total due from members and the Lloyd's Central Fund (LCF) to GBP 45,158k, this amount was settled during the financial year.

prior_year_events.event_name: Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves
prior_year_events.impact_description: liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5,833k prior to its closure

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves in 2016, totaling GBP 118.75m, representing 21.54% of opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was driven by worse-than-anticipated loss experience across all years of account, leading to a recalibration of reserves. Specifically, liabilities for the 2007 underwriting year were strengthened by GBP 5.833m prior to its closure, related to Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is a sum of the movement calculated from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2011-2014 (+GBP 112.917m) and an explicitly stated strengthening for the 2007 underwriting year (+GBP 5.833m).
